props.name: value
props.description: The saved branding. Edits are a draft against this until saved.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Persist the draft. Return a promise to show the saving state; reject to show its message.

props.name: onLogoUpload
props.description: Receive a chosen logo file and return the URL to store. Defaults to a local object URL.

props.name: defaultColor
props.description: Where Reset returns the colour to. Defaults to the library’s first accent preset.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Named colours offered in the picker. Defaults to the accent presets.

props.name: minContrast
props.description: Label contrast below this ratio raises a warning. 4.5 is WCAG AA; 7 is AAA.
